Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: Lie algebras | ID: 53642

Statement

Let H be a Sobolev space. Every self-adjoint operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Step 2. Applying the Holder interpolation theorem to \(W_{01280012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. By compactness of the compact spectral family \(V_{01280013}\), the image is precompact in the Besov space topology.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01280011 \cdot C_01280012 \cdot C_01280013\).
